# czc-v2026.10.25.1 (0.2.17.30)

Kiro2Claude account connectivity tests no longer claim Claude Code
identity. Other groups keep the previous Claude Code probe.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.24.3

### Kiro2Claude connectivity test

- Admin and intelligent tests for accounts in the `Kiro2Claude` group
  omit `You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.`
- Those probes also omit Claude Code client headers (`User-Agent:
  claude-cli/...`, `X-App: cli`) and the `claude-code-20250219` beta
  token.
- kiro-rs injects its own Kiro identity. Sending a second Claude Code
  claim made Opus 5.5 write that conflict into visible text.
- Accounts in other groups still use the Claude Code test payload.
- Live gateway traffic is unchanged: API-key accounts still do not
  inject Claude Code identity; Claude Code clients still send their
  own prompt.

## VERSION

`0.2.17.30`

## Upgrade guidance

Drop-in. No database migration and no configuration change.

Retest `kiro-rs-ip` from the admin account test dialog after deploy.
The probe should greet without the Kiro-vs-Claude-Code reasoning.

## Compatibility

- Production forwarding, billing, and scheduling are unchanged.
- Channel-monitor probes are unchanged.
- Non-Kiro2Claude Claude tests still mimic Claude Code.

## Rollback

Redeploy `czc-v2026.10.24.3`, or restore the backup
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.25.1-<UTC timestamp>` created
during this deploy and restart `sub2api.service`. Rolling back restores
Claude Code identity on Kiro2Claude connectivity tests. Live traffic
and billing are unchanged.
